messages:
mira: running a canary onboard for raven-lite-int4-ptq; noticing a class of outputs where the model emits truncated JSON for funcalls. quick notes and action plan below.

alex: can you paste a raw example?

mira: sure — example from raw stream:
```
{ "action": "create_ticket", "args": { "title": "Payment failure", "details": "user_id: 123" 
```
(no closing braces, no final "arguments" wrapper)

jamal: is this reproducible on int8 or only int4?

mira: reproduced across variants but frequency differs. quick stats on the same prompt set (n=5k): float16 parse_success=98.7%, int8=95.2%, int4=82.1%.

alex: wow — do failures correlate with prefix length or kv-cache hits?

mira: yes. failures spike when the prefix has >1200 tokens and when kv-cache reuse rate is high. hypothesis: quantized kernels + continuous batching produce token drops / early EOS tokens.

lucy: can we isolate sampling vs caching? i.e., run with fixed seed + kv flush per request.

mira: plan: (1) reproduce with seed-fixed sampling and kv_flush per-call, (2) reproduce with hot-prefix + normal caching, (3) run deterministic canary config (temperature=0.02, top_p=0.1) that forces single-object funcall style. results due EOD.

sre-bot: deploy canary: raven-lite-int4-ptq-v2 -> us-west for 2h window (auto-rollbacks enabled).

jamal: about retries — propose lightweight retry: 1 quick retry after 150ms backoff with a small wrapper that asks for JSON-only output, and increment telemetry `parse.retry_short`. if still malformed, kick json-repair prompt.

alex: i'd rather add a strict funcall mode variant for the canary where the model must return a single top-level `arguments` object (no prose), force low temp, and disallow streaming. that's less heuristic-y than repair prompts.

mira: i'll run both approaches in parallel. telemetry slices to add: model_variant, kv_prefix_hash, prompt_length_bucket, tokenizer_seq_len, retry_count. also capture `parse.success`, `parse.repair.attempts`, `funcall.duplicate_blocked`.

lucy: reminder: ensure retry idempotency tokens are included so downstream side-effects aren't doubled.

mira: noted — adding idempotency header and will emit `idempotency.blocked=true` when duplicate suppressed.

alex: threshold guidance: if int4 parse_success remains <90% on canary we should not promote it to Dedicated without either (a) model-side fix or (b) lightweight post-processor that repairs JSON.

mira: timeline: run replays + deterministic run (4k samples) -> attach raw samples + small analyzer script (node) -> PR telemetry dashboards. will report summary in ~6 hours.

alex: if you hit anything odd, ping me and i'll help triage kernel scheduling and batching knobs.

mira: thanks — will post back with numbers and a tiny sample set.
